page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and it does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor architecture for this instance does not support advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), or specialized cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI). Additionally, hardware-level virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyper-threading (HT) flags are unavailable on this configuration. These hardware limitations restrict the instance from executing highly parallelized vector calculations or nested virtualization workloads.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.large offers a predictable compute profile for lightweight workloads. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for entry-level tasks that require dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of high-capacity memory or local storage. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, small-scale microservices, and simple background utility tasks.
